description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 rate (%) for the GPT-4o model, with data points plotted at 5, 10, 20, and 40 reasoning steps. The x-axis, labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)," is also linear, spanning from 0 to 100 with major gridlines every 20 units. Two lines are displayed: a solid blue line with circular markers representing GPT-4o, and a dashed light blue line with 'x' markers. The GPT-4o line starts at 6.5% at 5 reasoning steps, increases to 32.3% at 10 steps, rises sharply to 77.4% at 20 steps, and reaches 83.9% at 40 steps. The light blue line begins at 19.4% at 5 steps, rises to 38.7% at 10 steps, peaks at 87.1% at 20 steps, and slightly decreases to 89.2% at 40 steps. Both lines show a general upward trend, with the light blue line consistently above the GPT-4o line across all plotted points.
